description: How have Spanish house prices moved? Paid ($0.03 USDC): INE quarterly housing price index (IPV) for Spain and each autonomous community, general / new / second-hand, latest, 4-quarter and 12-quarter change (INE table 25171, CC BY 4.0; no endorsement by INE). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/es-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
